reviews.title: Love the schedule feature
reviews.text:
UPDATE:
This has changed my life. Willpower was never enough for me so this has been a game changer. I am so much more productive and happy! 

I’ve been using this for two days now, but I’ve had the device for almost two months and just hadn’t got myself to be discliplined enough to use it each day. I finally got on the app and set a schedule so that I couldn’t just ‘forget’ to tap my card each morning. What a game changer!!! It’s been humbling to see how badly my mind wants to just grab my phone and preoccupy every possible extra second with stupid social media. Love love love this product and will encourage others to get one as well!!!

reviews.title: Love the idea, could use way better UI
reviews.text: I absolutely love the idea of this card, but there are just a few very odd UI experiences. It’s honestly not super user friendly on how to setup and to schedule different time blocks. I don’t love that you have to first pick a category, and then pick the apps to block or not block, go pick a time slot and select a given category. I want to be able to just select time blocks and what apps to block. Kind of an annoying double workflow.

reviews.title: Super buggy
reviews.text: Amazing app in concept. It worked for a while but then became super buggy and I troubleshoot, fix it, then there’s another bug

reviews.title: Has a mind of its own
reviews.text: I love the concept and the device has been extremely successful in keeping me off social media. But the schedule I set up works as expected only some of the time. Sometimes it will put my phone into focus mode randomly in the middle of the day. Sometimes it will not be in focus mode during a scheduled focus session. If these glitches were worked out, it would be fantastic.

reviews.title: Bloom
reviews.text: I love my bloom card. I use it everyday, and have for over a year. It really helps me stay off my phone, specifically the doom scrolling. I don’t think it’s a perfect solution for everyone, I’m sure there are sneaky ways to get around it, but for me, it works great. I also love that I own the card. No subscription service required. Thanks bloom!!!

reviews.title: Does not work consistently
reviews.text: It sometimes works and often doesn’t. I’ve contacted them for help and their support was not helpful. I regret giving them my money.

reviews.title: Bugs affect function
reviews.text: Very effective when the blocks are active, however they regularly fail to trigger, making the app regularly useless.

reviews.title: Too buggy
reviews.text: Loved the app and how it helped me monitor and limit my time on social media. However, I found it too buggy to continue using. Every time my phone OS updated the schedules would stop working—either blocking when they shouldn’t (in which case there were no options to fix the schedule while blocking was on) or not blocking during a set schedule (in which case I would check the schedules and confirm that they were set correctly and the app just wasn’t working properly. Each time I had to delete and reinstall the app and go through an EXTREMELY tedious and un-skippable onboarding questionnaire. I reached out to support and they basically confirmed that I would have to continue periodically reinstalling the app until the end of time. To this I say no thank you! Deleted and switched to another solution.

reviews.title: Great overall, but could use time limits
reviews.text: The schedule function is great for keeping me off my phone when I wake up and before I go to sleep, but I think app time limits would also be super useful. Apple’s time limits are too easy to override so I think Bloom’s physical card would be great for this. Please let me know if this is something you’ll be working on adding! :)

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: App picker crazy

reviews.title: Prevents bedtime doomscrolling
reviews.text: Our phones are filled with apps engineered to get you to engage with them as much as possible. Bloom lets you block these apps on a daily schedule. I use it to block all nonessential apps every night before bed and my sleep has improved significantly since. Although unblocking your phone is easy (all you need to do is scan the card or use a monthly emergency escape), the extra friction required to open up a distracting app makes it more tempting to put down the phone and go to sleep instead.

reviews.title: Bring back the fun block screens

reviews.text: I love it! It’s a great idea and app. But sometimes it will lock my apps (all of them) all day which is outset of the schedule I set. I need some apps for work and I sometimes can’t access my card. If we could fix the random constant blocking apps bug that would make this app perfection!

reviews.title: Complete Life Transformstion
reviews.text: When I say the bloom card has genuinely changed the way I live my everyday life, I am not exaggerating. I now have control over my time, which was almost impossible to get 100% control of before I had the bloom card. With this newly added time and focus, I can actually commit to every single little thing I say I am going to do. I have had experience with other social media blockers in the past and none of them worked. There was always a very simple way to bypass all of them, and when your brain is addicted to something, you are destined to find that easy way out. With the bloom card, you can set up systems that make the app impossible to bypass or even delete which I’ve never seen in a screen time blocker before. To anyone who wants any sort of success in this world, I recommend this product to you. Buy the bloom card, take back your time by force, and by default ➡️ you take back your life.

reviews.title: IT WORKS!!!
reviews.text: I’m not normally someone who writes reviews, but this deserved my praise. I’m a content creator, so I’m naturally online quite a bit, but my screen time had gotten out of hand. This is a great way to gain some hours of your life back, and well worth the investment of $35 and change. Get a bloom!

reviews.title: Perfect for an adhd brain
reviews.text: I was so sick of knowing I had an addiction to my phone and the internet, I could hear my inner voice yelling to stop as I was sucked into scrolling or picking up my phone first thing in the morning. I’d wish that my phone could just text/make calls, play music/books, take photos and hive directions but without the access to anything else. No scrolling, no constant news cycle, no dopamining in the worst way. I would loose hours and hours to it . I now have my phone set up to only allow the things I actually want access to and I can feel my brain coming back into its creative power. This is such a helpful tool, it is pricey but I choose to think of it as a one time purchase medicine to help my brain.

reviews.title: Schedules have a mind of their own
reviews.text:
To elaborate on the title. The schedules feel like they’re just for show. Several times I’ve been locked out of apps when I shouldn’t have been. Other times I’m locked out of the wrong mode. Once I was even locked out of an app that was on zero of my block out modes. I have deleted this app several times and ultimately end up going back only bc it’s the only way I can decrease screen time. I wish they’d work out the bugs. Also!! make it so I don’t have to go through the stupid unskippable set up dramatization of how much the app will help me every time I need to delete and redownload bc of bugs, especially since I have to log in first. Like you already know I have an account. Leave me alone



Update!! Request for the developers: can there be a 30 second warning notification before your break is about to end. Let me know I need to wrap it up before the blackout happens

reviews.title: Good app, one knit pick
reviews.text: I feel like the app should allow cross device access, like one device is in focus mode, and the other device can be in focus mode as well, without the need for an nfc. The manual blocking on the ipad does not have the same physical boundary to unblock, and serves more as an act of discipline. If this change was possible, please make it an option. Thank you for your product.

reviews.title: Too many bugs
reviews.text:
The app is definitely useful but for the amount I have paid for the card, bugs such as 

1. Scheduling not working as expected.  (Apps getting blocked at random times, or not getting blocked at all)
2. App showing focus mode is on, but no apps are being blocked.
3. Apps not getting unlocked even though schedule is showing it’s free time.

Make it impossible to use this app predictably and makes it a frustrating experience.

I found that if I restart my phone, the setting automation shortcut lags by about 3-5 minutes and in that time I can turn off the apps connected to screen time… thus turning off bloom access. I feel like it’s more of an issue with my phone, but I wish there was a solution.

reviews.title: It’s pretty useful but there are major bugs
reviews.text:
Been using for almost a year now here are some pros and cons

Pros: 
Cheaper than brick
Will save you a lot of time if used properly (I suggest giving it to a family member or telling them to put it in a safe)
You can block websites with them as well as apps

Cons:
The scheduling feature doesn’t work properly sometimes. I noticed that sometimes when you schedule a blocked time it doesn’t block it. 

Also sometimes I noticed that after I use my 5 min break it doesn’t automatically go into the correct scheduled blocker and instead activates my scheduled blocker for when I sleep (which blocks everything).

On top of that one time I noticed it didn’t block a specific website even though it was blocking the rest of the stuff I wanted

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Seriously the best thing I’ve ever implemented for my mental health. Bloom has blocked the temptation of phone distraction and helped me set healthy boundaries about work time and personal time. I’m so much more present and efficient when using bloom. Forever grateful for this app!

reviews.title: Buggy with unblocking
reviews.text:
I have it on a schedule where I allow myself specific times of the day to be on restricted apps and websites on the phone. More than once those apps and websites are still blocked even during “free” times. Sometimes Bloom says that I’m still restricted, but sometimes it says that I’m free and the apps are still restricted. 
One workaround I’ve found, is to manually re-block and unblock using the card, but since I don’t take the card with me everywhere, this isn’t viable. 
Otherwise appreciate the functionality of the app and that it’s really limited the amount of time I spent on social media.
